title: SurfaceRegistration
description: Payload a surface publishes when registering with the orchestrator (Family A v1). Source: docs/implementation/02_surface_orchestration_http.md (Surface Registration Contract).

surface_kind.description: Registered surface type (e.g. chat, files, config, context, context-history, context-visualizer). The registry is open-ended; new kinds attach without changing existing surfaces.

attach_token_fingerprint.description: Non-secret fingerprint of the ephemeral attach token; raw token is never persisted.
